title: Decisions (Jev)
intro: Lets fleet ask TypeSafe's decision model closed-set questions. Experimental and off.

items.text: Data goes only for organisations that opted in, redacted, and a model answer only ever pre-selects a suggestion you confirm. Set the key with fleet-hub decide set-key.
Each use case is off, shadow or assist. Shadow only records; assist pre-selects an answer you confirm. There is no auto mode.

items.hint: An offline benchmark only until J1 passes its acceptance lines (D32).
Pre-selects the repository when a task's first start has none; you still press Start.
Pre-ticks the other repository a ticket start also needs; you still press Start.
Pre-selects a new session's host when two or more online hosts under their limit are left; you press Create.
Puts the likely option first in an agent's question or a form; you still answer. Never a push or a permission.
Prefills the project when you adopt a pane fleet did not start; you still press Adopt.
Prefills the project when you restore a conversation found on a host; you still press Restore.
Marks a proposed task that may repeat an existing one; you still merge or keep both.
Proposes a group for a new task nothing placed; you still place it.
Marks another of your sessions that works on the same thing; nothing is stopped or merged.
Says which mission or session a message in Control is about; you can change it. A short message gets a question instead.
Checks a watcher's summary of a session against its transcript; in assist a summary it cannot confirm is not shown.
Sends Claude's last reply, redacted, only for organisations that allow reply text. Hooks always win.
Proposes a stuck mission's outcome and next step; you still choose. It never completes a mission or sets Verified.
Keeps runs with nothing to do out of the Inbox. Sends the run's last reply only for organisations that allow reply text.
Asked once per PR shepherd episode. Sends check names and states, never code.
Marks the main ticket in Review when a session's first prompt names several; you still confirm it.
Marks a new local task in Review that may repeat a tracker ticket; linking the ticket instead is yours.
